description: Source code for the Hyperlink class in the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel namespace, defining hyperlink objects with properties, methods, and serialization logic.

classes.name: Hyperlink
classes.description: Represents a hyperlink in a document, supporting different types (local, file, web, bookmark) with methods for creation, cloning, and serialization.

classes.name: Hyperlink.HyperlinkValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for Hyperlink, including font, filename, bookmark, type, and other settings.

methods.name: CreateMailLink
methods.description: Creates a mailto hyperlink, automatically adding the 'mailto:' protocol if missing.

methods.name: CreateWebLink
methods.description: Creates an HTTP/HTTPS hyperlink, adding 'http://' if no protocol is specified.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Hyperlink object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the deep copy operation for the Hyperlink object.

methods.name: AddText
methods.description: Adds text to the hyperlink elements.

methods.name: AddChar
methods.description: Adds a character or repeated characters to the hyperlink elements.

methods.name: AddCharacter
methods.description: Adds symbol characters or characters defined by a character to the hyperlink elements.

methods.name: AddSpace
methods.description: Adds space characters.

methods.name: AddTab
methods.description: Adds a tab character.

methods.name: AddFormattedText
methods.description: Adds formatted text with various overloads for text, font, format, or style.

methods.name: AddBookmark
methods.description: Adds a bookmark field.

methods.name: AddPageField
methods.description: Adds a page field.

methods.name: AddPageRefField
methods.description: Adds a page reference field.

methods.name: AddNumPagesField
methods.description: Adds a number of pages field.

methods.name: AddSectionField
methods.description: Adds a section field.

methods.name: AddSectionPagesField
methods.description: Adds a section pages field.

methods.name: AddDateField
methods.description: Adds a date field, with optional format.

methods.name: AddInfoField
methods.description: Adds an info field of specified type.

methods.name: AddFootnote
methods.description: Adds a footnote with optional text.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Adds an image from a filename.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds existing document objects like Bookmark, PageField, etc.

methods.name: Font
methods.description: Gets or sets the font used in the hyperlink.

methods.name: NoHyperlinkStyle
methods.description: Boolean indicating if the hyperlink should look like surrounding text without hyperlink style.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Gets or sets the target bookmark or filename depending on hyperlink type.

methods.name: Filename
methods.description: Gets or sets the target filename or URL.

methods.name: BookmarkName
methods.description: Gets or sets the target bookmark name.

methods.name: NewWindow
methods.description: Specifies if the hyperlink opens in a new window.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Gets or sets the hyperlink type (local, file, web, bookmark).

methods.name: Elements
methods.description: ParagraphElements defining the clickable area of the hyperlink.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Converts the Hyperlink object into DDL format.

methods.name: AcceptVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for traversing the document object model.

methods.name: Meta
methods.description: Meta information for the Hyperlink class.
